title: net1 v4 training data, 60 s episodes
description: Training data for net1 v4: 1,200 links, two conditions each from a broad set of 64, three controllers per link, 60 s episodes so competition can settle, every 6th step kept (examples/net1_broad.py, set train60).
prepare: for s in train60; do uv run python examples/net1_broad.py "$OUT/spec-$s" --set $s --models "$IN/models"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$s/campaign.json" "$OUT/campaign-$s"; done
run: for s in train60; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$OUT/campaign-$s" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps --steps-stride 6; done
collect: echo '| set | status |' > "$OUT/summary.md"; echo '|---|---|' >> "$OUT/summary.md"; for s in train60; do uv run expliccit campaign status "$OUT/campaign-$s" > "$OUT/status-$s.json"; echo "| $s | $(jq -c . "$OUT/status-$s.json") |" >> "$OUT/summary.md"; done
